title: Shi-type estimates and finite-time singularities of reasonable flows of Spin(7)-structures
summary: This paper establishes foundational analytic and geometric results for a broad class of reasonable flows of Spin($7$)-structures. We first prove Shi-type derivative estimates, showing that a uniform bound on the quantity \[ Λ(x,t)=\left(|\mathrm{Riem}(x,t)|_{g(t)}^2+|T(x,t)|_{g(t)}^4+|\nabla T(x,t)|_{g(t)}^2\right)^{1/2} \] implies bounds on all covariant derivatives of the Riemann curvature tensor $\mathrm{Riem}$ and the torsion tensor $T$.
